connector.name: Perplexity Agent
connector.registryDescription: Multi-step web research with citations via Perplexity's Agent API. Standard library only.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package perplexity-agent-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the zalez account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PERPLEXITY_API_KEY
env.description: Your Perplexity API key. Read at call time and sent only as an Authorization header to api.perplexity.ai; never logged or echoed.

env.name: PERPLEXITY_AGENT_WAIT_SECONDS
env.description: How long a blocking call waits before handing back a response_id to collect later. Defaults to 55, just inside Claude Desktop's unconfigurable 60s tool-call timeout. Raise to 300 on clients without that limit.
